decisions.reason: A low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the firm's established textile and interior know-how, so it can read the early market response and refine the design within its existing collection.
A hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's material expertise and craftsmanship, giving it strong absorptive capacity to assimilate feedback and position it in its premium range.

This decorative carpet is closely related to existing products and benefits from established designer collaborations, though overlap with similar carpets in the range slightly raises the risk of pruning.
A corner bench extends the firm's core seating and furniture competence, so it can apply its craftsmanship and customization skills to adapt it for residential and hospitality projects.
